title: Kiosk KYC attestation
description: The decoded JWS payload of a KYC attestation, the POST /kiosk/agents/kyc request body, the request_kyc answer, and the data of the kyc_verification event that delivers the attestation.

attestation.description: Signed by the KYC provider, verified with its configured public key.

level.description: Binary; anything other than "verified" is rejected.

iss.description: MUST equal the provider-configured KYC issuer.

aud.description: OPERATOR-BINDING. The operator the attestation was minted for. MUST equal the operator's configured kyc_audience (its origin, or a stable handle it declares); the operator rejects any other aud. This stops a claim minted for operator A being replayed to operator B.

iat.description: Issued-at timestamp. Not enforced by the verifier.

attributes.description: OPTIONAL named ANONYMIZED boolean attributes the KYC provider vouches for (e.g. age_over_18, licence_a). Anonymized: the provider learns only these booleans -- never the underlying DOB, licence number, or document. Additive: a bare attestation with no attributes still verifies as binary. Only values that are literally true are honoured; a downstream Action MAY gate on required attribute names and reject with kyc_required (403) when they are not all present-and-true.

kyc_jws.description: The attestation as a compact RS256 JWS.

verification.description: The answer to the request_kyc action: a verification opened at the KYC provider, whose page the AI assistant relays to its human.

request_id.description: The provider's id for this verification; the kyc_verification event carries it back.

verification_url.description: The provider page the human completes.

verificationEvent.description: The data of a kyc_verification event: the human approved, and the event carries the provider-signed attestation to submit to POST /kiosk/agents/kyc.

kyc_jws.description: The attestation as a compact RS256 JWS.
